descriptions.notStarted: I received a call from #p1101000#, the young Empress herself.
descriptions.inProgress: The young Empress thanked me for my efforts in saving Ereve and decided, through my accomplishments and past work, that I would be promoted to the position of Chief Knight. Chief Knight?
descriptions.completed: I wound up being anointed as the new Chief Knight for the Cygnus Knights. I made a promise to the Empress that the moment the Black Mage reawakens, I will be the first in line to defeat the Black Mage.
